standard_prerequisites.name: The compatibility of the formation of differentials with taking stalks, and the description of the naive cotangent complex of a presentation over a ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 5966-5972 as pointers to a lemma of this chapter and to a section of another chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the required quasi-isomorphism to the corresponding statement in commutative algebra.

core_obligations: Reduce to comparing two presentations: since the complex of the identity presentation is the one attached to the algebra, the proof replaces the statement by the construction of a canonical quasi-isomorphism between the complexes of two arbitrary presentations (proof lines 5949-5952)

Amalgamate the presentations: taking the coproduct of the two indexing sheaves and of the two structure maps, the proof produces a common presentation receiving both, together with maps of the two complexes into the complex of the amalgamation (proof lines 5953-5964)

Check on stalks: it suffices to show those maps are quasi-isomorphisms, which may be checked on stalks, where the complexes become the naive cotangent complexes of the corresponding presentations of algebras (proof lines 5965-5972)
Conclude: the algebraic statement comparing the complexes of two presentations of the same algebra gives the result (proof lines 5973-5974)
proof_roadmap: 先注意 NL_{B/A} = NL(id_B)，故只需比较两个展示给出的复形：取 E = E_1 ⊔ E_2 与 α = α_1 ⊔ α_2，得 A[E_i] → A[E] 且 J_i ↦ J，于是有复形映射 NL(α_i) → NL(α)。
只需证这些映射是拟同构；因可用茎检验（lemma-abelian），而茎上就是交换代数中同一代数的两个展示的 NL 复形（algebra-section-netherlander），由跨章的 NL-homotopy 引理得证。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement asserts that the complex attached to a presentation of a sheaf of algebras is canonically independent, up to canonical quasi-isomorphism, of the presentation chosen (author lemma at source lines 5942-5946, label lemma-NL-up-to-qis). The proof (source lines 5948-5975) reduces to comparing the complexes of two arbitrary presentations by amalgamating them into a common presentation, produces the comparison maps, and checks that they are quasi-isomorphisms on stalks, where the statement is the corresponding algebraic one; the set-up paragraph defining the complex is reproduced as a context span. The amalgamation of presentations and the reduction to stalks are the content. H2.
